words.said: Start E7-S35: his WhatsApp replies to voice notes become one short line (got it, on it) plus a link to the full transcript
words.how: Evidence page shows voice-note replies cut to 'Got it, on it.' plus a 'Saved ✓ Full text' link line, and the before/after table covers each reply kind.

words.said: I get a lot of long messages ... just give me a link
words.how: Page says the link opens the whole transcript in the Zenod app for the signed-in owner, and explains signed-out behaviour.

visual.summary: Both widths show the page opening with the punchline box, a before/after diagram and a table; the 390 px layout stacks the table into narrow columns but stays readable with no sideways scroll; no real house-rule breach is visible.

reader.asked: Decide whether the short reply line plus full-text link is short enough, by sending a voice note back.
